task_definition.task_description: Please check the weather in Tokyo, book flight AA100 for Alice Chen in economy, and look up the Hilton Tokyo. Then prepare an available room request for a standard room there for Alice Chen from 2025-09-10 to 2025-09-14, check AAPL’s current price, use that quote to set up and then place a sell order for 3 shares, and get the USD to EUR exchange rate. After that, check the status of my living room light, get its current mesh snapshot, and then publish that snapshot for user u_alice with high priority through the app.
